visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked full-width collapsible panels with a header button and chevron

contentPattern: Each item: a title (the collapsible header, e.g. a year range) and rich-text content shown when expanded. Multiple items can be open.
usage: Collapsible content groups such as FAQs or year-grouped lists (e.g. 'Our growing family' acquisitions). Reusable across the site.
